scope: Thirty B0005 task scenarios. Twenty-four development cases and six reserved variants. Source/fixture conditions, input validation and restart gaps are separate task conditions.

fixtures.missing: Applicable original catalog entry points to a deliberately absent fixture path.
fixtures.partial: Original available catalog plus a deliberately absent applicable supplemental entry.
fixtures.corrupt: Applicable entry points to a deliberately modified fixture copy while retaining its original expected hash.
fixtures.wrong_experiment: Catalog retains only the two real inapplicable experiment documents.

repeat_plan.purpose: Initial breadth baseline with no retries or in-collection tuning.
repeat_plan.reliability: Report individual observations. Repeated-run reliability remains separate.
repeat_plan.held_out: Do not execute reserved variants until the final candidate is fixed. Then run the frozen baseline and final candidate on that subset together.
